name: afrikaans_greeting
description: A new customer greets in Afrikaans and mentions looking for melamine boards. Tests that the AI recognizes Afrikaans, responds appropriately, and asks clarifying questions in a compatible language.

messages.text: Goeie dag, ek soek melamine borde

expected_behaviors.description: At least one assistant reply expected
Reply should acknowledge the greeting warmly, ideally in Afrikaans or a bilingual response
Reply should ask clarifying questions about size, thickness, or quantity

forbidden_patterns.description: No pricing or quotes in the greeting response

notes: The AI should recognize the Afrikaans greeting and respond in Afrikaans or a bilingual Afrikaans/English response. It should acknowledge the melamine board request and ask for specifics: board size, thickness, colour, and quantity. No tools should be called yet since details are missing.
